task: F-05 connected UI acceptance for measurement, Owner-approved payment, partial payment, correction, cancellation, and cumulative totals
scope: Payment-specific browser test, isolated Playwright config, and evidence handoff only. No production or shared-schema changes.
verifiedFlow: SUP authors and activates a Contract BOQ in the live UI/API workflow; CON submits a QuantityMeasurement; SUP records claimed 80.125 and verified 70.125 through the real measurement commands.

CON submits a PaymentClaim from the measurement. SUP prepares and submits the server calculation recommendation (850 VND); SUP authors an exact-version Owner Decision request through Owner Governance, and OWN acknowledges and decides it through that UI.

OWN adjusts the claim to 800 VND using the resulting exact Decision reference, preserving the 850 VND recommendation. ADM records partial payments of 500 and 100; corrects the first payment to 450; cancels that correction; and records the remaining 700. Earlier payment rows stay unchanged as correction and cancellation entries append.

SUP closes the claim. Persisted payment history has five entries; paid, cumulative certified, and cumulative paid amounts are 800 VND and unpaid balance is zero. UI detail displays all five payment references. Owner view does not offer the ADM payment-recording action.
